Machine Learning Engineer

Northgate Recruitment Solutions Leeds, West Yorkshire £50,000 - £60,000 per annum

Our client, a growing fintech, is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join its data team.

You will build and monitor models that score payments for risk, working in Python with scikit-learn and PyTorch, and deploy them as services on AWS with Docker and GitHub Actions.

  • 2 years of experience in a machine learning role
  • Strong Python and SQL
  • Experience with model monitoring and evaluation

Apply with your CV and we will contact you if you are shortlisted for this vacancy with our client.
